name: SG8 observation-consensus self-attention propagation
selection: each family and track selected independently on four VOC-Sim folds and evaluated on the held-out fold
tie_break: within the registered 0.002 tolerance prefer the candidate closest to the reference: trim10 over trim20 over median; larger tau; larger rho
transfer: COCO-Cap uses the setting and threshold chosen on VOC-Sim and never selects
storage: compact counts and per-image diagnostics only; generated images, maps, affinities, and propagated vectors are discarded
